title: Prince Family Paper
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael and Dwight undertake a covert mission to gather intelligence on Prince Family Paper, a small family-owned business. They visit the company under false pretenses, collect a client list, and ultimately decide to give this information to David Wallace, risking harm to the family business. Along the way, Dwight applies for a job at the company, they accidentally damage their car, and the office engages in a humorous debate about Hillary Swank's attractiveness.
